exp.connectedTip: Backend Connected Field params sync in real time across all connected clients via Socket.IO
exp.localTip: Local Mode Backend unreachable · all physics run client-side · no multi-client sync
exp.regimeBadgeTip: Active Physics Regime Schwan: transmembrane voltage from Kotnik & Miklavcic 2000. Resonance: acoustic Lorentzian lineshape (bacteria, virus). CW: wf=0.5 (sinusoidal). Pulsed: wf=1.0 (square). H-FIRE: Vth × 1.75 per Arena et al. 2011.
exp.logEmpty: No readings yet, click Log Reading to record
exp.tipThDepH: H Re[K], Healthy DEP Clausius-Mossotti factor Re[K(f)] for the healthy cell at log-time frequency. Re[K] > 0 → pDEP (attracted to field maxima) Re[K] < 0 → nDEP (repelled from field maxima) Hidden in resonance mode (model invalid at GHz).
exp.tipThDepT: T Re[K], Target DEP Clausius-Mossotti factor Re[K(f)] for the target cell at log-time frequency. Re[K] > 0 → pDEP (attracted to field maxima) Re[K] < 0 → nDEP (repelled from field maxima) Hidden in resonance mode (model invalid at GHz).
exp.zDriftTip: ⚗ Impedance Drift Detected Medium conductivity has shifted from baseline by more than 5%. This typically indicates ion release from lysing target cells. Click to open the Instrument Panel for real-time impedance tracking and corrected field voltage.
exp.stickyScrollTip: Click to scroll back to the cell cards
exp.copyLinkTip: Share Experiment Setup Copies a URL that restores this exact configuration: cell pair, frequency, field, waveform, and all other parameters. Paste it into a browser to open the same setup instantly.
exp.outcomeStripTip:
Live Protocol Predictions Real-time physics-model outputs for the current cell pair and protocol. All values are simulator predictions (Schwan, Pennes, BMS models), not measured data.

Each chip is clickable and scrolls to the panel that explains it in depth.
exp.outcomeTiTip: Therapeutic Index Ratio of target to healthy disruption: DR_T / DR_H. Higher is better; ≥2 is a strong window, 1.0 to 2.0 is marginal. Bracketed range is σ_i uncertainty (mammalian ±20%, bacteria ±35%, virus ±45%). Click to scroll to the Selectivity panel.
exp.outcomeDrTTip: Target Disruption Ratio Fraction of Vm_threshold reached in the target cell. ≥85% sustained triggers lysis. Click to scroll to the Disruption Ratio chart.
exp.outcomeDrHTip: Healthy Disruption Ratio Fraction of Vm_threshold reached in the healthy cell. Keep below 50% to stay in the reversible/safe regime. Click to scroll to the Disruption Ratio chart.
exp.outcomeTssTip: Steady-State Temperature Pennes-bioheat prediction: max(T_ss_H, T_ss_T). ≥1°C above 37 = heating; ≥42°C = hyperthermic damage. Click to scroll to the Disruption Ratio chart (thermal zone overlay).
exp.outcomeBiomodTip: Biomodulation Score Simulator construct, not from cited works. Weighted blend of sub-lytic SI, MTE, MA for the healthy cell. ≥0.55 = “nourishing” regime. Click to scroll to the Healthy cell card biostim panel.
exp.equationStripTip: Live Equation The exact formula being evaluated for the current protocol, with every parameter substituted. Numbers update in real time as you change field intensity, frequency, orientation, or cells. Click the derivation button to open the full model in the Protocol documentation.
exp.equationStripNoResonance: No resonance defined for this cell
exp.equationStripDerivationTip: Open Derivation Jumps to the Protocol documentation section that derives this model from first principles, with citations and caveats.
exp.outcomeModeTip:
Protocol Mode Tiered verdict on how the current pulse acts on the cell pair:

Sub-threshold: target DR below 50%, no lysis expected. Approaching Window: target DR ≥50%, not yet lytic. Marginal Window: target lyses, but healthy DR is also elevated. Selectivity Window: target lyses (DR ≥85%) and healthy stays reversible (DR below 50%). Ablative: both populations lyse, no selectivity.

The same tiers drive the Selectivity panel mode badge.
exp.outcomeSnapTip: Snap Frequency Sets the broadcast frequency to {freq}, where selectivity peaks at {sel} for this cell pair, medium, and waveform. Recomputed live: the optimum shifts with σ_e, pulse count, and temperature.
exp.outcomeSnapTipBeyond: Optimal Outside Slider Range The computed peak sits at {freq} ({sel}), beyond the accessible slider range. Clicking snaps to the nearest slider edge. To reach the true peak, switch to a higher-conductivity medium or widen the frequency range.
exp.outcomeSnapTipNoWindow: No Selective Window Across the scanned frequency range, the best selectivity ratio is {sel} at {freq}. Healthy-cell disruption exceeds target at every frequency. Clicking snaps to the least-bad frequency for reference. To open a window, adjust field, waveform, medium, or pulse count, or pick a different cell pair.

drChart.title: Disruption Ratio: f-Domain
drChart.tipTitle: Disruption Ratio vs Frequency Shows DR(f) = Vm(f) / Vthreshold × PEF for both cells. Green region: selectivity window, target DR ≥ 85% while healthy DR < 50%. Dashed amber line = reversible EP boundary (50%). Dashed red line = lysis threshold (85%).
drChart.sectionTip: DR(f) = Vm·PEF / Vm_thr, Amber dashed = Rev-EP 50% · Red dashed = Lysis 85% · Green fill = selectivity window (target ≥ 85%, healthy < 50%)
drChart.zoomTip: Toggle Y-axis scale. Zoom: fits axis to current data range (min 20%). Full: always shows 0-110% with both threshold lines visible.
drChart.disclaimerLowField: Both cells are below 5% DR across all frequencies. Increase the field intensity to see meaningful disruption curves.
drChart.disclaimerBacteriaVirus: Bacteria and virus targets cannot be disrupted at IRE field strengths. These cell types require acoustic resonance protocols (GHz). Switch to Resonance mode.
drChart.thermChipTip: Predicted Steady-State Temperature Max of Pennes-bioheat estimate for healthy and target cells: T_ss = 37 + SAR·dc / (λ·cp). · cool (<38.5°C): negligible heating · nourishing (38.5–41°C): mild thermal activation window · warm (41–42°C): hyperthermic stress · hot (≥42°C): thermal-damage regime — reduce field or duty cycle Model assumes uniform field and neglects convective mixing; valid for in-vitro approximation only.
drChart.logModeTipSchwan: Schwan mode row Logged while chart was in Schwan (membrane voltage) mode. Vm, selectivity and Re[K] columns reflect this physics model.
drChart.logModeTipResonance: Resonance mode row Logged while chart was in acoustic resonance (Lorentzian) mode. DR columns reflect the lineshape model at GHz; Vm/DEP columns are not applicable.
